title: Code Review Automation Pipeline
brief: Wire PRISM's physics/formula knowledge into Claude's automated code review bot for domain-aware PR reviews. Configure claude-code-action and claude-code-security-review GitHub Actions. Create REVIEW.md with PRISM-specific rules. Build specialized review agents for physics correctness, dispatcher wiring, and test coverage. Multi-agent parallel dispatch for PR review. CI integration to block merge on P0 issues.

phases.title: Code Review Automation Pipeline
phases.description: Configure GitHub Actions for automated PR review, create PRISM-specific review rules, build specialized review agents for physics/dispatcher/test correctness, aggregate into unified CI-blocking reviews.

units.title: claude-code-action setup
units.rationale: Configure anthropics/claude-code-action GitHub Action for PRISM repo to auto-trigger on PR open, providing the foundation for all subsequent review automation.
exit_conditions: claude-code-action triggers on PR open
Action runs successfully on test PR
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

steps.instruction: Create .github/workflows/claude-review.yml with anthropics/claude-code-action@v1
Configure trigger on pull_request opened/synchronize events
Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY secret reference and model to claude-opus-4-6
Test with a dummy PR to verify action triggers and completes

deliverables.description: GitHub Action workflow for automated Claude code review on PRs

units.title: claude-code-security-review setup
units.rationale: Add security-focused review scanning for injection vulnerabilities, credential leaks, and unsafe eval patterns specific to PRISM's MCP server and engine architecture.
exit_conditions: Security review runs on PR
Detects intentionally planted test vulnerability
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

steps.instruction: Create .github/workflows/claude-security-review.yml with anthropics/claude-code-action security review config
Configure security-specific prompt: scan for eval(), credential patterns, SQL injection, path traversal
Add PRISM-specific security rules: MCP endpoint auth checks, dispatcher input validation, engine sandbox boundaries
Test with intentional vulnerability to confirm detection

units.description: claude-code-security-review setup — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: REVIEW.md creation
units.rationale: Create PRISM-specific review rules document that Claude references during reviews, covering formula correctness, dispatcher wiring conventions, schema sync requirements, and test coverage expectations.
entry_conditions: Understanding of PRISM conventions from MASTER_INDEX_COMPACT
exit_conditions: REVIEW.md in repo root
Covers formula, dispatcher, schema, test rules
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

steps.instruction: Document formula correctness rules: Kienzle Fc=kc1.1*ap*fz^(1-mc), Taylor T=(C/Vc)^(1/n), deflection delta=FL^3/3EI must match constants.ts
Document dispatcher wiring rules: new engines must be exported from index.ts, wired to dispatcher z.enum, have action schemas
Document schema sync rules: action schemas must match dispatcher cases, z.enum must include all action names
Document test coverage rules: every engine needs companion .test.ts, minimum 10 assertions, physics engines need dimensional analysis tests

deliverables.description: PRISM-specific code review rules for Claude reviewers

units.description: REVIEW.md creation — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Physics-aware review agent
units.rationale: Build a specialized review agent that checks Kienzle, Taylor, deflection, and other physics formulas against canonical constants.ts to catch formula regressions in PRs.
features: Physics formula regression detection in PRs
exit_conditions: Agent detects formula regressions in test PR
Catches wrong exponents, missing terms, hardcoded vs canonical values
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

steps.instruction: Create physics-reviewer.ts that parses diff for formula patterns (kc1_1, mc, fz, ap, Vc, C, n)
Cross-reference detected formulas against src/physics/constants.ts canonical values
Flag: hardcoded values that should reference constants, wrong exponents, missing dimensional checks
Output structured findings with severity (P0=wrong formula, P1=hardcoded, P2=style)
Test with synthetic PR containing intentional formula errors

units.description: Physics-aware review agent — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Dispatcher consistency reviewer
units.rationale: Check that new engines are properly wired: exported from index.ts, added to dispatcher z.enum, have matching action schemas, and ToolRouter patterns updated.
features: Dispatcher wiring gap detection in PRs
exit_conditions: Agent detects unwired engines in test PR
Catches missing z.enum entries, missing schemas
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

steps.instruction: Create dispatcher-reviewer.ts that parses diff for new engine files and class definitions
Check index.ts for corresponding export
Check relevant dispatcher for z.enum action entry and switch case
Check action schema file for matching schema definition
Output findings: missing exports, unwired actions, schema gaps

units.description: Dispatcher consistency reviewer — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Test coverage reviewer
units.rationale: Verify that new engines have companion test files with minimum assertion counts, physics engines have dimensional analysis tests, and no test files are empty stubs.
features: Test coverage gap detection in PRs
exit_conditions: Agent flags missing test files for new engines
Detects stub tests with <5 assertions
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

steps.instruction: Create test-coverage-reviewer.ts that identifies new engine files in diff
Check for companion .test.ts file in tests/ directory
Count assertions (expect/assert calls) in test file, flag if <10
For physics engines, check for dimensional analysis test patterns
Output findings with severity levels

units.description: Test coverage reviewer — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Anti-regression review rules
units.rationale: Flag removed exports, changed action names, modified schemas without migration, deleted dispatcher cases, and reduced z.enum entries -- all common regression patterns in PRISM.
exit_conditions: Agent catches removed exports in test PR
Flags action name changes without migration
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

steps.instruction: Create anti-regression-reviewer.ts that analyzes diff deletions
Detect removed exports from index.ts
Detect changed action names in dispatcher z.enum
Detect modified schema shapes without version bump
Detect reduced case count in dispatcher switch statements
Output P0 findings for any regression pattern

units.description: Anti-regression review rules — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Multi-agent parallel dispatch
units.rationale: Run 3+ review agents in parallel (physics, dispatcher, test coverage, anti-regression), aggregate findings into a single structured PR comment with severity-sorted results.
features: Parallel multi-agent review with unified output
exit_conditions: Orchestrator runs all agents in parallel
Single unified PR comment posted with all findings
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

steps.instruction: Create review-orchestrator.ts that spawns all review agents via Promise.all
Collect findings from each agent into unified structure
Sort by severity (P0>P1>P2), deduplicate overlapping findings
Format as single GitHub PR comment with collapsible sections per agent
Post comment via GitHub API (gh pr comment)
Update GitHub Action workflow to use orchestrator

deliverables.description: Multi-agent review orchestrator with parallel dispatch

units.title: Review metrics tracking
units.rationale: Track review findings count, false positive rate (user-dismissed findings), catch rate (issues found before merge), and review duration to continuously improve review quality.
features: Review quality metrics persistence and reporting
exit_conditions: Metrics persisted to JSON after each review
Dashboard query available
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

steps.instruction: Create review-metrics.ts that records each review run: PR number, findings by severity, duration
Track false positives via reaction emoji or dismiss comment pattern
Persist to data/review-metrics.json with append-only log
Add summary stats: rolling 30-day catch rate, false positive %, avg duration
Add CLI query: node scripts/review-agents/review-metrics.ts --summary

units.title: CI integration — merge blocking
units.rationale: Configure GitHub branch protection to require passing Claude review with no P0 issues before merge is allowed, making the review pipeline a true quality gate.
features: Merge blocking on P0 review findings
exit_conditions: PR with P0 issues cannot be merged
PR with only P1/P2 issues can merge with warning
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

steps.instruction: Update claude-review.yml to set check status based on findings severity
Exit code 1 (failure) if any P0 findings, exit 0 otherwise
Configure GitHub branch protection to require claude-review check
Add P1/P2 warning annotations without blocking merge
Test with P0-containing PR to verify merge is blocked

deliverables.description: Updated workflow with merge-blocking on P0 findings
